title: Softer Grindstone
description: This is a resource pack that lowers the volume of the grindstone sound, and also works with the Mechanical Grindstone from the Create: Enchantment Industry mod.
body:
## About:
This is a simple resouce pack that turns down the volume of the grindstone sound by -30dB.

### Compatibility:
It's compatibile with any mod that uses the base Minecraft grindstone sound.
So far the tested mods are:
- Create: Enchantment Industry


_**Only download from Modrinth for the safety of your computer.**_

## Extra:
This resouce pack was made in one day, because I thought the grindstone is annoying.

You can use this pack for whatever you want. Just don't be malicious with it!

Also I might release the pack on different versions of Minecraft. Who knows :P
